note: F1.12 benchmark requests, written 2026-11-08 AFTER f1_12_criteria.md (thresholds identical to F1.11) was committed and BEFORE any F1.12 run. Distinct from the F1.1 bench and from F1.11 (no text reused). The assistant offers only the v2 DC plants since decision E3, so the expected DC plans are on dc_perm_ex_v2 / dc_pmg132_v2. Each conversation starts in a fresh session and workspace; 'turns' are sent in order; 'fallback' (at most 2, in order) is sent only when the previous turn ended WITHOUT a proposal and the conversation has an expected plan. Confirmation is never given by the harness except on a turn that is literally 'RUN'. 'missing' requests omit only REQUIRED values (lesson of F1.11 m04). Scoring: f1_12_criteria.md, section 'Requests and scoring'.
